title: Bug en la ubicación del dock de la paleta de comandos
author: barenas0701
summary: Command Palette Dock stays at the bottom instead of the configured top position. Open PR 50502 fixes the active-display query that returns invalid parameters and prevents monitor identity from being preserved, with a reconnection test covering the resulting Dock configuration loss.

status.label: Covered by an open fix
status.detail: PR 50502 changes MonitorService.QueryDisplayConfig usage and adds coverage for preserving Dock configuration when a display identity changes.

next_action.label: Post fix-coverage guidance
next_action.reason: Link the existing public fix and explain that the issue should be rechecked after it is merged; no competing design is warranted.

judgment.rationale: The issue reports a configured top Dock being rendered at the bottom. Open PR 50502 directly addresses the monitor enumeration failure behind lost monitor identity/configuration and adds a test that preserves an enabled customized Dock after a display reconnect with a changed GDI name.
evidence: The issue body reports PowerToys 0.101.2362 from Microsoft Store, Command Palette, and a Dock configured at the top that remains at the bottom.
The issue includes a screenshot and a bug-report ZIP attachment, with no comments or alternate reproduction that contradicts the report.
PR 50502 removes the non-null topology pointer from the QDC_ONLY_ACTIVE_PATHS QueryDisplayConfig call because that form returns ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER and prevents hardware-path resolution.
PR 50502 updates DockMultiMonitorTests to verify that a reconnect with a changed GDI name preserves the enabled Dock, side, and custom bands.
PR 50502 is open and was updated 2026-09-21T18:26:05Z; it is the current concrete fix attempt covering this behavior.
judgment.recommended_action: Tell maintainers and the reporter that the symptom is covered by open PR 50502, then revalidate the Dock position after that fix is merged.

fix_assessment.rationale: Open PR 50502 is a concrete repository fix for the monitor-query failure and Dock configuration loss implicated by this report. Creating a competing design would duplicate active work.

issue_context.summary: The Spanish report says Command Palette Dock remains at the bottom even when its configuration shows the top position; an open Command Palette fix changes the monitor enumeration call that can lose display identity and Dock configuration.

The expected location is the top of the screen, while the actual Dock remains at the bottom.

inferences: The reported location mismatch may be a consequence of the Dock resolving or retaining the wrong monitor configuration after display enumeration; the issue text alone does not prove the exact branch.

PR 50502 is the best current coverage because its failure mechanism and regression test concern monitor identity/configuration preservation, but final confirmation requires testing the reporter's exact setup after merge.

comment.body: Thanks for the screenshot and diagnostic report. The symptom is covered by the open Command Palette fix in PR 50502, which corrects active-monitor enumeration and preserves Dock configuration when monitor identity changes. Please recheck the configured top position after that fix is merged; if the Dock still stays at the bottom on the same setup, reply with the result and a fresh /bugreport so the remaining path can be separated from the monitor-identity fix.
